input: Paint the front door a new color

gold.taskTitle: Paint the front door a new color
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to repaint their front door in a new color, and needs a clear plan to do it successfully.

questions.title: What color are you thinking of painting it?
questions.description: Identify the target color or general color direction the user has in mind.

questions.title: What material is the front door made of?
questions.description: Determine whether the door is wood, metal, fiberglass, or another material, as this affects paint type and prep.

questions.title: What color is the door currently?
questions.description: Know the existing color to plan for primer use and number of coats needed.

questions.title: Is the door exterior-facing and exposed to weather?
questions.description: Clarify whether the door is fully exposed, covered by a porch, or otherwise sheltered, affecting paint durability needs.

questions.title: Do you already have paint, brushes, or supplies?
questions.description: Find out what materials the user already has on hand versus what needs to be purchased.

questions.title: Will you remove the door or paint it in place?
questions.description: Determine the user's preferred approach, as removing the door allows for cleaner results but requires more effort.

questions.title: What is your target date to finish the door?
questions.description: Establish any deadline or timeframe the user is working toward to structure the plan accordingly.
